page: OVHcloud l40s-90 is a KVM-based Cloud GPU server powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9124 processor. It features 15 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz with one thread per core. The system is equipped with 90.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB per core, and includes 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the server includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The defining component of this server is its single NVIDIA L40S GPU, built on the Ada Lovelace architecture, featuring 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. In benchmark evaluations, this hardware configuration delivers top-tier performance in the top 10% for Large Language Model inference tasks. This includes prompt processing and text generation across small, medium, and large models. Additionally, the AMD EPYC CPU demonstrates strong single-core performance in stress-ng tests, while multi-core CPU, memory bandwidth, and database operations perform in the average range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the l40s-90 offers a balanced resource density by pairing a high-capacity 48 GB VRAM GPU with a moderate allocation of 15 dedicated CPU cores and 90 GB of RAM. This prevents the resource overhead and higher costs associated with multi-GPU configurations or oversized CPU nodes. This server is highly suited for AI and machine learning workloads, specifically LLM inference, prompt processing, and text generation. It is also well-suited for GPU-accelerated compute tasks, ray tracing, and data processing workloads that require dedicated CPU execution alongside high-capacity VRAM.
description: The OVHcloud l40s-90 is a KVM-based Cloud GPU server designed for high-performance accelerated computing. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 15 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz, paired with 90.0 GB of system memory and 400 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The server is equipped with a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing 48 GB of VRAM. In benchmark testing, the l40s-90 achieves top-tier performance in LLM inference, prompt processing, and text generation across various model sizes, alongside strong single-core CPU performance. With an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, this configuration is highly efficient for machine learning inference, ray tracing, and GPU-accelerated data processing. It offers a cost-effective alternative to multi-GPU nodes by matching a high-capacity GPU with a balanced, dedicated CPU and memory allocation.
